pair_design: 10 pairs/split; 4 direction, 3 measure, 3 speaker/role pairs; two opposite-target queries per pair. Not independent 20 Bernoulli trials. Gold requires exact issue, direction and role. Counterpart is irrelevant for this retrieval intent, not necessarily legally incorrect.
data_source: All legal-looking text is synthetic. No external legal text or services.
candidate_generation: Every method gets the identical 20 prewritten short passages. No retrieval, passage sampling, filtering or changed candidate generation in this comparison.
selection: Select once using dev MRR, then Recall@1, Recall@3, prefer existing E5 on ties, then declared order. Holdout only existing E5, BM25 and locked winner; original12 after lock as regression diagnostic.
model: Only existing Xenova multilingual-e5-small quantized ONNX; cached asset hashes verified; ONNX telemetry disabled. No extra model.
statistical_limits: Small synthetic convenience set with paired dependent queries; no legal accuracy or broad generalization claim. Grid of ten inexpensive configurations risks dev overfit. A non-improvement is reported honestly.
metric_definition: One relevant passage/query. Recall@K is TopK fraction, Precision@K is Recall@K divided by K, MRR is mean reciprocal rank, NDCG@K is 1/log2(rank+1) within K. All other candidates graded 0.

harness_amendment_before_holdout.reason: Concurrent production edits changed semantik.py after dev; original full-file hash correctly blocked holdout before any holdout inference. Pin original production source in frozen_e5_source.json so unchanged E5 scorer is reproducible.
harness_amendment_before_holdout.audit: Initial manifest, selection and dev results preserved as initial_*.json; dev rerun verifies the implementation-only amendment does not alter selection. No holdout score was observed before amendment.
